name: 1st Federal Savings Bank of SC, Inc.
summary: 1st Federal Savings Bank of SC, Inc. delivers a comprehensive range of financial solutions. For individuals and businesses, it offers diverse deposit products, including checking and savings accounts, Individual Retirement Accounts (IRAs), and Certificates of Deposit (CDs). The bank also facilitates numerous ancillary services, such as debit cards, overdraft coverage, check reordering, wire transfers, automated telephone banking, secure night deposit facilities, safe deposit box rentals, direct deposit, and automatic funds transfers, all complemented by robust online banking capabilities. Furthermore, it extends various lending options, from mortgages and personal loans to commercial financing, and features specialized Kasasa products. This financial institution commenced operations in Walterboro, South Carolina, in 1962.
